notes: «قالا» makes Ahmad and Ali the co-transmitters of the first level; «وإسماعيل بن إبراهيم» is a co-transmitter beside Sufyan
the variant group («وقد روي هذا الحديث عن ابن أبي نجيح عن أبيه عن رجل عن ابن عمر») names another route for the same saying: a remark, never a route
«سئل ابن عمر»: the one asked answers, so Ibn Umar is the last link; «أبو نجيح اسمه يسار» and the grading by the compiler are glosses, not links
